project: Wuxia Life P124 Non-Martial Tendency Summary Rebalancing
description: Summary-layer experience slice: rebalance tendencySummary so non-martial routes read like life directions instead of being repeatedly pulled back into combat by martial stat clustering.

userStories.title: Lock tendency summary input surfaces and sample states
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the tendency summary inputs and sample route states locked before changing ranking logic, so the work stays inside existing route, shaping, and stat wiring.
acceptanceCriteria: Document the current tendencySummary generation surface in buildTendencySummary within src/components/mainScreenModel.ts
Identify at least one non-martial sample context and one martial-dominant sample context for targeted verification
Confirm this stage only reads existing routeStatus, shapingSummary context, lifeStates, and existing player stats
Do not modify routeSummary, shapingSummary, full stats panel, or attribute definitions in this stage (PRD §4 Out of Scope, §7 Non-Goals)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PRD §3 Core Problem and §4 Scope. This story keeps P124 from leaking into P123 or P125.

userStories.title: Reduce repeated martial bucket dominance in tendency summary
userStories.description: As a player on a non-martial path, I want tendencySummary to stop being captured by multiple martial sub-stats that all point to the same combat direction.
acceptanceCriteria: tendencySummary reduces the chance that 2-3 martial candidates repeat the same martial signal in non-martial contexts
martialPower is treated as the primary overall martial readout when martial dominance truly applies, instead of allowing multiple sub-stats to crowd it
The change stays inside summary ranking or weighting logic and does not add a new tendency system
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implements PRD US-001/US-002 and FR-1/FR-3. This is the minimum martial-duplication correction.

userStories.title: Prefer route and shaping context for non-martial summary reads
userStories.description: As a player on a merchant or other non-martial route, I want tendencySummary to read my current life direction in context, so the summary cooperates with routeSummary and shapingSummary.
acceptanceCriteria: In non-martial route contexts, tendencySummary can prioritize existing non-martial signals such as route, shaping, knowledge, connections, charisma, or comprehension when appropriate
Merchant-oriented sample states can surface non-martial direction instead of falling back to generic martial emphasis by default
tendencySummary does not contradict routeSummary or shapingSummary in obvious ways after the change
No new route score, profession score, or hidden summary-only container is introduced
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implements PRD US-001/US-003 and FR-2/FR-4. Keep this limited to existing context signals.

userStories.title: Preserve martial readability for truly martial-dominant states
userStories.description: As a martial-heavy player, I still want tendencySummary to read martial when combat genuinely is my main growth axis, so the rebalancing does not overcorrect.
acceptanceCriteria: Martial-dominant sample states still produce a clear martial tendency summary
martialPower remains the preferred top-level combat readout when martial dominance is real
The summary does not become so route-driven that it hides actual martial-heavy progression
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implements PRD US-002. This story exists to stop the non-martial fix from breaking martial readability.

userStories.title: Add narrow regression coverage for tendency summary rebalancing
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want targeted regression checks for both merchant and martial sample states, so future edits do not silently drag tendencySummary back into the old combat-heavy pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update narrow tests for at least one non-martial sample state and one martial-dominant sample state
Regression verifies non-martial contexts can produce non-martial tendency summaries when appropriate
Regression verifies martial-dominant contexts still produce martial tendency summaries
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implements PRD §9 Verification Standard. Reuse existing mainScreenModel-oriented tests rather than building a large new harness.
